name: Transaction Parties 12
definition: Provides further details on the parties specific to the individual transaction.

InitiatingParty.name: Initiating Party
InitiatingParty.definition: Party that initiated the payment that is reported in the entry.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor.

UltimateDebtor.name: Ultimate Debtor
UltimateDebtor.definition: Ultimate party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party to which an amount of money is due.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Unambiguous identification of the account of the creditor to which a credit entry has been posted as a result of the payment transaction.

UltimateCreditor.name: Ultimate Creditor
UltimateCreditor.definition: Ultimate party to which an amount of money is due.

TradingParty.name: Trading Party
TradingParty.definition: Party that plays an active role in planning and executing the transactions that create or liquidate investments of the investors assets, or that move the investor's assets from one investment to another. A trading party is a trade instructor, an investment decision-maker, a post trade administrator, or a trader. In the context of treasury, it is the party that negotiates and executes the treasury transaction.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Proprietary party related to the underlying transaction.
